summary: Roles install to the first writable path in ~/.ansible/roles:/usr/share/ansible/roles:/etc/ansible/roles; override with ANSIBLE_ROLES_PATH, --roles-path, or roles_path in ansible.cfg.
questions: How do I install a role into my project directory?
How do I change the default roles path?

answer_card.title: Choose where roles are installed
answer_card.answer_md:
Default: first writable of `~/.ansible/roles:/usr/share/ansible/roles:/etc/ansible/roles`.

Override with any of:
- `ANSIBLE_ROLES_PATH` environment variable
- `--roles-path` option
- `roles_path` in `ansible.cfg`

```bash
ansible-galaxy role install --roles-path . geerlingguy.apache
```
